basic_profile.bio: An avid anime enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon, who has been exploring different genres for over a decade. Enjoys discovering hidden gems and sharing recommendations with fellow anime lovers. Works as a software developer during the day and spends evenings diving into both classic and new series. Single and enjoys the freedom to binge-watch anime without interruptions. Active on Reddit mostly during late-night hours, finding solace in the quiet and contemplative world of anime characters.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a solid foundation in computer science, thanks to a degree from Oregon State University. Developed an interest in technology and anime during college years. Self-taught in anime history, constantly expanding knowledge through forums, reviews, and community discussions.
